create_quantized_batchnorm2d: create a quantized BatchNorm2d module with num_features, eps, momentum, device and dtype parameters
create_quantized_batchnorm3d: create a quantized BatchNorm3d module with num_features, eps, momentum, device and dtype parameters
convert_float_batchnorm2d_to_quantized: convert a float torch.nn.BatchNorm2d module to quantized using from_float with activation_post_process qparams
convert_float_batchnorm3d_to_quantized: convert a float torch.nn.BatchNorm3d module to quantized using from_float with activation_post_process qparams
build_quantized_batchnorm_from_reference: build a quantized batch norm module from a reference float batch norm with custom output_scale and output_zero_point
